beats.narration: On Mon 9 Nov 2026, Marcus Tan of Bayside Business Accountants refers George Papadopoulos and Harpreet Kaur: Northcote Custom Joinery Pty Ltd, owned 50/50, valued at $2,400,000, and no succession plan.
Olivia's agent extracts the referral: two 50% owners, 14 staff, revenue of $3.1m and net profit of $520,000. It runs the in-good-order checklist for both partners.
Olivia opens case REQ-20261109-LIF003 for George (CL-104611) and Harpreet (CL-104612).
Felix's agent runs KYC on the company and both owners: the company extract and both IDs are legit, with no PEP or sanctions match.

Penny's agent works out the needs: buy-sell life and TPD cover of $1,200,000 each (half of $2.4m), each partner owning the policy on their own life, and $400,000 of key person cover on George, owned by the company. Their lawyer drafts the buy-sell agreement, and Marcus confirms the tax treatment.

Ivy's agent compares year-1 stepped premiums at standard rates: Northbank Life $8,620, Corella Life $9,180, Harbourline Life $9,410. Northbank has the business-protection features and fast financial underwriting.
The case totals $2,800,000 of cover, so Theo gives it a second review (every case of $2,000,000 or more gets one) before Amelia signs the Statement of Advice.

Uma's agent tracks the requirements: bloods, a medical and two years' financials for George; bloods and financials for Harpreet. George's cholesterol of 7.2 mmol/L and blood pressure of 150/95 bring a 25% loading on his life and TPD cover; Harpreet is standard. George accepts with Amelia on 19 Nov, and the premiums come to $10,000 a year.
Cara's agent writes to George and Harpreet, and tells Marcus, with their consent, that the cover is in place and their lawyer will finalise the buy-sell agreement.

result.headline: Business protected from 20 Nov 2026
result.summary: Outcome: COMPLETED — buy-sell cover of $1.2 million each and $400,000 key person cover in force from 20 Nov 2026 (policies NB-26300418, NB-26300419 and NB-26300420), with a 25% loading on George's cover.
